messages:
noah (product): quick sync: milestone at risk due to tenant SSO and embcache perf. two paths: delay for full SSO & embcache fixes, or ship MVP on time with guarded pilot SSO + trimmed embcache. leaning to keep ship date and use pilot toggles. need thumbs + owners by EOD.
riu (eng): tech note: full SSO touches auth flow + onboarding; embcache regression is a KV throttling issue. trimming embcache (LRU, prefix only) removes the risky eviction path. we can land that in a day.
clare (eng-runtime): KV bug root cause is in compaction window. patch exists but needs staging soak. recommend guarded rollout: patch to v1, MVP trims cache to stable path. For customers needing SSO now, offer "pilot SSO" behind manual enable.
dani (pm): customers: Acme & Helix asked for SSO in pilot. Helix can defer. Acme insists. propose: MVP = public GA w/out tenant SSO; enable pilot SSO for Acme only (manual, ops-assisted). v1 (T+9 days) = GA SSO + embcache patch + regression suite.
omar (sales): Acme will sign pilot if we guarantee manual enable + 24/7 on-call for first 72h. We must be explicit in contract language that this is pilot-only.
noah (product): strawman decision: ship MVP on schedule without GA SSO; provide a tenant-level pilot SSO for Acme (manual enable, ops-runbook); ship trimmed embcache for MVP; schedule v1 with patch and full SSO + test harness + perf verification in 9 days.
riu (eng): gating: before enabling Acme SSO, run integration smoke and perf run (script: `./tools/sso_smoke --tenant acme --duration 30m`). if error-rate >0.2% or 99p latency >500ms we abort.
clare (eng-runtime): I'll add KV eviction metrics and a canary job that simulates tail workloads: `infra/canary/kv_evict_test.yaml`. Also add alert if `kv_eviction_rate > 0.05`.
dani (pm): owners: riu -> acceptance criteria + smoke script; clare -> embcache instrumentation + alert; omar -> customer comms + contract clause; noah -> roadmap/PRD update and stakeholder notif.
omar (sales): I'll draft pilot terms and send to legal for a short addendum. Also arrange onboarding window with Acme ops.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: 13377 for release/mvp-cut. status: pending canary.
riu (eng): PR for trimmed embcache will go up today, and I'll include a feature-flag `feature:tenant_sso_pilot` behind ops toggle.
noah (product): decision logged. action items: publish roadmap change, create pilot runbook, set v1 buffer +9 days, contact legal & support. keep me posted in the doc thread. :white_check_mark:
